## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated descriptor at `plugins/<plugin-id>.json` (filename matches both `id` and `manifest.json`)
- [ ] Followed [`schema/plugin-descriptor.schema.json`](../schema/plugin-descriptor.schema.json)
- [ ] `source_url` points to a public `https://` `.zip` release asset (`<= 10 MiB` compressed, `<= 32 MiB` unpacked, no symlinks)
- [ ] `manifest.json` targets `api_version: 1` and requests only the minimal required permissions
- [ ] Tested locally in Fern via **Settings → Plugins → Install from ZIP…**
- [ ] (If updating) Summarized purpose and any new permissions above
